donations.title: Donations
donations.description: Buttons, modals, cards, and donation walls — drop-in primitives for one-time and recurring donations powered by Stripe Checkout.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.description: Subscribe buttons, plan cards, and the change-plan flow — every primitive needed to surface and manage recurring subscriptions.

billingPricing.title: Billing & Pricing
billingPricing.description: PricingPage, BillingDashboard, InvoiceHistorySection, the past-due banner, and Stripe Customer Portal launchers — full lifecycle billing UI.

purchases.title: Purchases & Marketplace
purchases.description: Single-purchase buttons and cards plus the marketplace primitives (ProductCard, ProductGrid, PaymentHistory) for one-shot product sales.

callbackPages.title: Callback Pages
callbackPages.description: Pre-built Stripe Checkout success and cancel landing pages — drop them onto `/subscribe/success`, `/donate/cancel`, etc. for instant flows.

connect.title: Stripe Connect
connect.description: Onboarding form, status card, fee summary, and the developer Connect dashboard — everything for marketplace-style platforms with multi-vendor payouts.

adminDeveloper.title: Admin & Developer
adminDeveloper.description: Federated admin dashboard, plans manager, the developer portal, API key creation modal, and the user payment dashboard — power-user surfaces for platform owners.

utilities.title: Utilities & Gates
utilities.description: Feature gates, confirm dialogs, promo code input, refund button, and the not-configured fallback — orthogonal primitives reused across flows.
